pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Smiling Outside the Tree Fort Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake the Dog smiling and waving outside the Tree Fort, with its connected leafy towers rising behind his rounded figure. The coloring sheet leaves broad open areas across Jake's body, contrasting with small windows, narrow bridges, a bent chimney, and a boat-shaped balcony above the grassy hills.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Making Bacon Pancakes in the Tree Fort Kitchen Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake the Dog makes bacon pancakes in the Tree Fort kitchen in this printable coloring page, holding a frying pan and raising a slotted spatula. Bacon strips and two pancakes fill the pan, while a round window, wood-paneled walls, and stove knobs add kitchen details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Admiring His Perfect Sandwich on the Kitchen Counter Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake the Dog admiring his perfect sandwich on a kitchen counter, grinning with both hands lifted beside his face. Layers of filling beneath a long scored loaf create narrow sections on the coloring sheet, balanced by Jake's large open body and the simple kitchen cabinets.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Playing Card Wars with Finn at the Game Table Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake the Dog plays Card Wars with Finn at a round game table in this printable coloring page, holding cards and raising one above his head. The coloring sheet shows Finn from behind with his backpack, while tiny corn plants, grassy board squares, loose cards, and stacked decks fill the tabletop.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Playing His Viola Beside Lady Rainicorn on a Grassy Hill Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake the Dog playing his viola beside Lady Rainicorn on a grassy hill, drawing a bow across the instrument's strings. Lady Rainicorn's long striped body curves behind him on the coloring sheet, with flowing hair, a spiral horn, small clouds, and scattered grass tufts completing the scene.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Playing an Acoustic Guitar While Finn Sings to Susan Strong Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake plays an acoustic guitar while Finn sings to Susan Strong in this printable coloring page, sitting on a log below the two standing characters. Strings, frets, and tuning pegs add fine details to the coloring sheet, alongside Susan's patterned boots and ragged outfit against an open grassy landscape.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Playing the Fire Guitar for Flame Princess in the Fire Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Jake the Dog playing the Fire Guitar for Flame Princess in the Fire Kingdom, with tall pointed towers behind them. Flame shapes outline the guitar and the princess's hair and gown, while strings, tuning pegs, and diamond-shaped decorations supply smaller sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Singing with Lady Rainicorn at the Battle of the Bands Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake the Dog sings with Lady Rainicorn at the Battle of the Bands in this printable coloring page, standing at separate microphones on a stage. Curtains frame the performers on the coloring sheet, and a drum kit, speakers, curling microphone cables, and long floorboards add details around their open body shapes.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Dancing Beside a Tiny Bug in the Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake the Dog dancing beside a tiny bug in the forest, lifting one knee and both arms beneath leafy trees. His rounded body offers a large coloring area, while the bug's curved pincers and thin legs provide smaller details among the grass and rocks on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Playing a Video Game on BMO in the Tree Fort Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake the Dog plays a video game on BMO inside the Tree Fort in this printable coloring page, sitting on a cushion with a wired controller. BMO's smiling screen, differently shaped buttons, and slender limbs add small sections to the coloring sheet, alongside a round window, wooden ladder, and plank floor.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Sharing a Fist Bump with Finn in the Ice Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake the Dog sharing a fist bump with Finn in the Ice Kingdom, both smiling beneath a skyline of pointed towers. Short marks emphasize their touching fists, while Finn's backpack, Jake's rounded muzzle, and broad snowy slopes create distinct coloring spaces across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Riding Lady Rainicorn Above the Candy Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake the Dog rides Lady Rainicorn above the Candy Kingdom in this printable coloring page, raising both arms as she flies between rounded clouds overhead. Her flowing mane and long striped body sweep across the coloring sheet, with pointed castle turrets and scalloped rooftops clustered below the airborne pair.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Caring for His Five Newborn Puppies Beside Lady Rainicorn Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake the Dog caring for his five newborn puppies beside Lady Rainicorn, gathered closely on a soft folded blanket together. The puppies have individual horns, markings, and hairstyles, including a heart, a star, and a flower, creating small decorative sections among the broader shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Competing with Charlie at the Card Wars Doubles Tournament Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake the Dog competes with Charlie at the Card Wars doubles tournament in this printable coloring page, both holding cards behind a large game board. Charlie's horn and ponytail, Jake's raised fist, and crossed-sword banners distinguish the coloring sheet, with winding rivers and angular mountains dividing the board into smaller areas.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Giving Kim Kil Whan a Handmade Ocarina Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake the Dog giving Kim Kil Whan a handmade ocarina, offering the small instrument while the taller character reaches forward. Its round finger holes, Kim Kil Whan's striped horn and pointed beard, and scattered grass tufts add compact details to the otherwise open coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Skateboarding with Bronwyn at the Skate Park Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake the Dog goes skateboarding with Bronwyn at the skate park in this printable coloring page, balancing on a board beside her helmeted figure nearby. Bronwyn wears elbow pads, knee pads, and a lightning-bolt dress, while ramps and railings add broad geometric shapes behind the two skateboards on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Cooking Fried Rice for Jermaine in the Family Kitchen Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake the Dog cooking fried rice for Jermaine in the family kitchen, stirring a large pan while Jermaine watches nearby. Individual grains and diced ingredients supply small details on the coloring sheet, with bowls, chopped vegetables, cabinets, and a refrigerator surrounding the central cooking scene.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog as a Baby Being Held By Joshua Beside Margaret Coloring Page
pages.description: Baby Jake the Dog is held by Joshua beside Margaret in this printable coloring page, smiling with his small arms lifted between the two adults. Joshua's brimmed hat and Margaret's long ears frame the family on the coloring sheet, which has broad body shapes and a plain white background.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Investigating Clues with Finn at the Candy Kingdom Train Station Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake the Dog investigating clues with Finn at the Candy Kingdom train station, bending over a paper with a magnifying glass. A passenger train, striped station posts, and candy-topped towers add setting details to the coloring sheet, while the two characters remain prominent in the foreground.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Dressed as a Milkman Delivering Bottles in the Candy Store Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake the Dog delivers bottles in a candy store in this printable coloring page, dressed as a milkman with a peaked cap and collared shirt. Three bottles sit in his wooden crate, and shelves of lollipops, round sweets, and striped candy canes create smaller repeated shapes throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Practicing Ice Ninja Moves with Nunchaku in the Ice King's Secret Chamber Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Jake the Dog practicing ice ninja moves with nunchaku in the Ice King's secret chamber, standing with his feet apart. The linked chain and cylindrical handles provide small coloring details, while pointed crystals, hanging icicles, and a rolled scroll surround Jake's broad figure on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Wearing His Star-covered Wizard Robe at Bufo's Magic School Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Adventure Time's Jake wearing a star-covered wizard robe and pointed hat beside Bufo at the magic school. Book-filled shelves, a potion flask, and moon-and-star banners surround the pair, with large robe sections and smaller outlined motifs across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Watching Death Play Drums in the Land of the Dead Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Jake before Death's drum kit in the Land of the Dead, with his paws clasped and mouth open. Bone-shaped hardware, a skull on the bass drum, and floating musical notes add smaller details around Jake's broad silhouette on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Hiding Inside a Protective Chalk Circle From the Ghost Fly Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, a worried Jake stands inside a protective chalk circle while the Ghost Fly hovers nearby in the Tree Fort. The fly's veined wings and long snout contrast with Jake's rounded body, while floorboards, a ladder, and a circular window fill the coloring sheet's setting.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Using a Sextant on the H.m.s. Sugar Spit Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, Jake peers through a sextant aboard the H.M.S. Sugar Spit, standing beneath its sail with the sea behind him. The instrument's marked arc and small mirrors provide compact details, while Jake's body, the sail panels, and the peppermint-patterned railing create larger sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Meeting Whipple the Happy Dragon Beside the Sailboat Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake waving from a sailboat toward Whipple the Happy Dragon, whose long neck and smiling face rise above the water. Curving ripples surround the dragon, and the boat's striped sail, round decorations, and wavy hull trim divide the coloring sheet into distinct areas.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Watching the Ice King's Video Diaries with Finn and BMO Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake and Finn watch the Ice King's video diaries through BMO in this printable coloring page, seated together on a couch with smiling faces. A stack of video tapes rests beside BMO, whose screen displays the crowned Ice King, while wooden walls and broad cushions frame the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Holding a Message Sign During His Silent Challenge with Finn Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, Jake and Finn hold message signs during their silent challenge, each displaying a heart beside a round smiling face. Jake raises his larger sign in the foreground, with Finn standing behind him among grass tufts and clouds on this clearly outlined coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Finding Tree Trunks' Missing Apples Spilling From a Cupboard Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake finding Tree Trunks' missing apples spilling from an open cupboard, kneeling with one apple held in his paw. Tree Trunks watches from behind as fruit rolls across the floorboards, giving the coloring sheet repeated rounded shapes alongside the cupboard's larger rectangular panels.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Caught in a Giant Spider Web Beside Finn and Two Spiders Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake and Finn are caught in a giant spider web in this printable coloring page, with raised arms and strands wrapped around their bodies. Two smiling spiders occupy opposite corners, while the web's curved bands and radial spokes create a patterned background across the entire coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Dressed as the Conductor Aboard the Mystery Train Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Jake as the Mystery Train conductor, standing in an open carriage doorway with a peaked cap and ticket punch. His buttoned jacket, tie, and pocket chain add smaller costume details, while the train's panels, wheel, and steps provide larger shapes on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Cheering for James Baxter as the Horse Balances on a Beach Ball Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, Jake claps for James Baxter as the smiling horse balances all four hooves on a large beach ball nearby. The horse's flowing mane and tail add curved details above the ball's broad panels, with a sparse shoreline and clouds behind the coloring sheet's main figures.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Preparing to Face the Farm Beside Finn in a Rocky Clearing Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake preparing to face the Farm beside Finn, who holds his sword upright in a clearing scattered with rocks. The enormous barn-shaped creature towers behind them on long limbs, combining broad character areas with smaller roof panels, trees, and stones throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Resting Beside a Treasure Pile Inside the Dungeon Train Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake rests beside a treasure pile inside the Dungeon Train in this printable coloring page, sitting with his paws on his bent knees. An open chest holds coins and faceted gems, with more pieces scattered on the floorboards, while riveted walls and a broad window enclose the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Sharing Prismo's Pickles in the Time Room Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake sharing Prismo's pickles in the Time Room, holding an open jar against his body and raising one pickle. Prismo's angular figure stretches across the wall behind him, while circles and star-shaped marks surround the larger character outlines on this sparsely patterned coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Dreaming of Banana Man's Rocket Ship in Outer Space Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, Jake sleeps curled on a cushion while dreaming of Banana Man waving from a rocket ship in outer space. A large thought bubble surrounds the rocket, stars, and crescent moon, separating the spacecraft's small rivets and windows from Jake's broad sleeping form on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Filming a Movie with Finn and BMO at the Tree Fort Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake filming a movie at the Tree Fort, holding a camera toward Finn while BMO waves beside them. Finn raises a fist in front of the wooden wall, with a ladder, round window, and distant treetops adding smaller background details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Wearing a Masquerade Eye Mask at the Creepy Castle Dinner Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake wears a masquerade eye mask at the creepy castle dinner in this printable coloring page, seated behind an empty plate and a fork. His tied mask and rounded silhouette stand against a tall chair, cracked arched window, goblet, and three-candle holder, balancing large and narrow areas across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Fixing Hot Daniel the Truck with Banana Man Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, Jake fixes Hot Daniel the truck with Banana Man, raising a wrench beside the exposed engine under its hood. Hoses, pipes, and the circular air cleaner add mechanical detail, while the truck's grille, windshield, and large tires form broader sections on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Carrying Royal Tarts Through the Candy Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page follows Jake carrying three royal tarts through the Candy Kingdom, holding a tray before towers decorated with icing and sprinkles. Each tart has a fluted crust, swirled topping, and strawberry slice, adding small repeated shapes around Jake's broad body on the sweet-themed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Watching Joshua's Recorded Message Inside Dad's Dungeon Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, Jake and Finn watch Joshua's recorded message inside Dad's Dungeon, facing a screen that shows him wearing a hat. A small projector rests on a stone block, and Jake holds his paws near his chest beneath the chamber's cracked arches on this detailed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Admiring Jermaine's Abstract Paintings at His House Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake admiring Jermaine's abstract paintings at his house while Jermaine gestures toward two canvases displayed on wooden easels. Circles, rectangles, a triangle, and sweeping lines divide the paintings into clear sections, with a potted plant and fringed rug completing the coloring sheet's room.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Watching a Knife Storm Through the Tree Fort Window Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake watches a knife storm through the Tree Fort window in this printable coloring page, sitting on a stool with his paws held close. Falling knives and a cleaver fill the sky beyond the large window, above rounded tree buildings and connecting bridges that add fine details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Entering the Wish-granting Labyrinth with the Hot Dog Knights Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake entering the wish-granting labyrinth with three Hot Dog Knights, walking beneath a leafy arch toward the hedge-lined passages. Their plumed helmets add narrow details beside Jake's open body shape, while the maze's squared turns form a repeating background pattern on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Eating Ice Cream Beside the Giant Magic Pods Coloring Page
pages.description: On this printable coloring page, Jake eats an ice cream cone beside three giant magic pods, with one opened pod packed with more cones. The cone's crisscross pattern and rounded scoops add small sections, while Jake's seated figure and the pods' large curved shells leave broad spaces on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Meeting Businessmen Frozen Inside an Iceberg on the Beach Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake meeting three businessmen frozen inside an iceberg on the beach, studying the ice with one paw near his chin. Their suits and ties appear between angular cracks, while the shoreline, scattered rocks, and open sky surround the larger ice formation on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Confronting Tiny Me-mow Beside Wildberry Princess's Pie Coloring Page
pages.description: In this printable coloring page, Jake confronts tiny Me-Mow beside Wildberry Princess's pie, leaning toward the small cat underneath a round wooden table. The pie's lattice crust and fluted dish provide repeated enclosed sections, while Jake's larger outline and the plain wall keep the coloring sheet's scene easy to distinguish.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Standing with Finn and the Key-per at Mount Cragdor's Locked Gate Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake standing with Finn and the Key-per at Mount Cragdor's locked gate, surrounded by jagged peaks and cracked stones. The Key-per wears a tall hat and a large key necklace beneath the gate's oversized keyhole, adding smaller shapes to the coloring sheet's broad wooden panels.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Reuniting with Jake Jr. After the Baker's Shard Heist Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake reunites with Jake Jr. after the Baker's Shard heist in this printable coloring page, extending his arms toward her beside an open treasure chest. Her swept-up hair and star-shaped facial detail stand out near the chest's crown, beads, coins, and faceted gems, adding varied shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake the Dog Reuniting with Finn Among Flowers in the Dead Worlds Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake reuniting with Finn among flowers in the Dead Worlds, smiling beside him as Finn rests a hand on his head. Large blossoms frame their legs, with smaller flowers and distant ruined towers spreading across the hills behind the two central figures on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake in Pumpkin Patch Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake from Adventure Time sitting in a pumpkin patch, waving beside large pumpkins with curling vines and pointed leaves. Rounded pumpkin sections surround his broad body, while the coloring sheet adds smaller leaf veins, stems, and distant hills beneath a partly hidden sun.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake in Wizard Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake wears a crescent moon wizard hat in this printable coloring page, sitting inside a stone tower with a spiral staff beside a steaming cauldron. Books, potion bottles, and a crystal ball add compact details to the coloring sheet, contrasting with his open body shape and the broad hat brim.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake on Floating Island Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Adventure Time's Jake sitting cross-legged on a floating island, with a leafy tree, small flowers, and clouds around him. The island's pointed rocky underside and hanging roots give the coloring sheet angular details beneath the rounded character, while scattered birds occupy the open sky.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake in Royal Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: Adventure Time's Jake stands in a royal garden on this printable coloring page, surrounded by flowers, an ornamental gate, and a castle with fluttering flags. His rounded body provides a large open area on the coloring sheet, with smaller shapes in the gate scrollwork, tree leaves, and curving paving stones.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake Posing in Gemstone Mine Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake poses with both palms raised in this printable coloring page, winking among faceted crystals in a gemstone mine beside a pickaxe and filled barrel. Large crystal points frame the coloring sheet, creating straight-edged sections around his curved silhouette, while smaller gems and loose stones appear across the cave floor.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake Looking Around in Snowy Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page follows Adventure Time's Jake looking around a snowy forest, with snow-covered evergreen branches, a fallen log, and a mountain behind him. His stepping pose fills the center of the coloring sheet, while layered tree boughs, scattered tracks, and curved snowbanks divide the surrounding winter landscape.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake Pointing in Candy Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake points across a candy forest in this printable coloring page, stretching one arm toward striped trees beside a spiral lollipop and gummy bear. The long pointing gesture leads across the coloring sheet, while candy cane bands, rounded treetops, and a winding striped path supply contrasting patterns around his plain body.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake Posing in Wizard Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake posing in a wizard tower, wearing a star-decorated hat and holding a tall staff with his other arm extended. Potion bottles, a candle, and a large closed book furnish the coloring sheet, with smaller patterns on a rug and an arched window containing a crescent moon and stars.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake Waving in Adventure Camp Coloring Page
pages.description: Boot-wearing Jake waves at an adventure camp in this printable coloring page, standing on a winding trail between a log cabin and a pitched tent. Evergreen trees and rounded mountains form the background of the coloring sheet, with finer details in the cabin logs, window frames, tent ropes, and scattered pebbles.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake Standing on Floating Island Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page places Adventure Time's Jake standing on a floating island, raising one hand above grassy ground dotted with rocks and small trees. Two smaller islands drift among clouds behind him on the coloring sheet, whose broad central figure contrasts with the cracked, pointed rock formation below his feet.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake Jumping in Enchanted Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: Adventure Time's Jake jumps through an enchanted forest in this printable coloring page, spreading his arms beneath a crescent moon as leaves drift nearby. A winding stream curves below him on the coloring sheet, while branching trunks, exposed roots, and small stars add detailed areas around his airborne pose.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake Looking Around in Gemstone Mine Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake looks around a gemstone mine in this printable coloring page, holding his hands near his chest beside crystal-covered walls and a loaded mine cart. pages.title: Adventure Time Jake Walking in Candy Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Adventure Time's Jake walking through a candy forest, passing giant spiral lollipops, striped candy trees, and a curved candy cane. His long crossing stride sits within a winding trail on the coloring sheet, where swirls and bands offer smaller sections beside his large unpatterned body.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake Sitting in Magical Village Coloring Page
pages.description: Seated Jake fills the foreground of this printable coloring page, resting in a magical village with mushroom houses, a tree-shaped cottage, and a winding path. Rounded paving stones lead between the buildings on the coloring sheet, with tiny windows, chimney details, mushrooms, and outlined stars surrounding the broad character shape.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake Pointing in Moonlit Meadow Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Jake pointing across a moonlit meadow, with an open-mouthed smile, a large crescent moon, and scattered stars above rolling hills. The coloring sheet keeps generous space around his outstretched arm, while small flowers, grass tufts, and rocks introduce compact details along the lower edge.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake Walking in Ice Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake walks through the Ice Kingdom in this printable coloring page, taking a long stride between angular formations and crystal clusters beneath snow-tipped mountain peaks. Broad stretches of ground and open sky surround him on the coloring sheet, balanced by narrow crystal facets and fine cracks along the winding route.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake Walking in Desert Canyon Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Adventure Time's Jake walking through a desert canyon, with towering layered cliffs, distant rock spires, and a cactus behind him. The winding canyon floor carries the eye past his stepping pose on the coloring sheet, while cracks, ledges, pebbles, and sparse plants break up the broad rock surfaces.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake Walking in Training Arena Coloring Page
pages.description: Adventure Time's Jake walks across a training arena in this printable coloring page, passing a stone wall topped with spear points and a square tower. Wide ground areas frame the character on the coloring sheet, with smaller sections in the masonry, scattered paving slabs, and bare trees rising over the distant hillside.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake Walking in Cloud Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page follows Jake walking through the Cloud Kingdom, with castles resting on clouds and small stars scattered around his four-legged silhouette. Rounded cloud banks fill the lower coloring sheet, while tower windows, pointed roofs, and curling wind marks add finer details across the otherwise open sky.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake Posing in Fantasy School Coloring Page
pages.description: Jake poses in a fantasy school on this printable coloring page, waving beneath a star-and-moon wizard hat with a buckled satchel slung across his body. An engraved stone arch frames him on the coloring sheet, while books, a crystal ball, tall windows, and a sword-decorated banner furnish the surrounding hall.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake Standing in Peaceful Campsite Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Jake standing with hands on his hips at a peaceful campsite, smiling with closed eyes beside a tent and campfire. A backpack rests near the crossed firewood on the coloring sheet, with small stars, a crescent moon, pine trees, and rolling hills surrounding the open central scene.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake Sitting in Desert Canyon Coloring Page
pages.description: Adventure Time's Jake sits cross-legged on a rock in this printable coloring page, surrounded by desert canyon cliffs, scattered stones, and a tall branching cactus. His hands rest near his knees on the coloring sheet, whose broad rock ledges contrast with the cactus spines, small desert plants, and outlined sun above.

pages.title: Adventure Time Jake Waving on Cliffside Path Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Jake waving on a cliffside path, with a low rope fence, steep rock faces, and a distant castle across the valley. The winding trail gives the coloring sheet long open sections, while smaller rocks, grass tufts, pine trees, and flag-topped castle towers provide detailed accents.

pages.description: Jake walks through a secret hideout in this printable coloring page, stepping beneath a stone arch near a hanging lantern, stacked crates, and coiled ropes. A compass and sword picture decorate the cave wall on the coloring sheet, while a scroll-topped table and cracked paving stones supply additional small sections.
